summary: validate-modules codes for incompatible defaults, reserved argument names, invalid argument specs, invalid documentation YAML or markup, invalid examples, and bad extensions.
questions: Why can't I name a module option 'message'?

answer_card.title: validate-modules codes (invalid specs and docs)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `incompatible-choices` / `incompatible-default-type`: values incompatible with type
- `invalid-argument-name`: `message` and `syslog_facility` are reserved
- `invalid-argument-spec(-options)`: spec or suboptions malformed
- `invalid-documentation`, `invalid-examples`: not valid YAML
- `invalid-documentation-markup`: bad markup in DOCUMENTATION/RETURN
- `invalid-extension`: must be `.py` or `.ps1`
- `invalid-module-schema`: AnsibleModule schema error
